name: Mastodon
description: Federated microblogging platform for text, image and video posts that interoperates across ActivityPub servers.

envVars.description: Public domain the instance is served from
Secret used to encrypt two-factor auth secrets

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DB_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-postgres"
      DB_PASS: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      REDIS_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-redis"
      LOCAL_DOMAIN: {{env.LOCAL_DOMAIN}}
      SECRET_KEY_BASE: {{env.SECRET_KEY_BASE}}
      OTP_SECRET: {{env.OTP_SECRET}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/public-system:/mastodon/public/system
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: mastodon
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: mastodon
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
  {{serviceName}}-streaming:
    image: ghcr.io/mastodon/mastodon:latest
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-streaming
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: "node ./streaming/index.js"
    environment:
      DB_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-postgres"
      REDIS_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-redis"
  {{serviceName}}-sidekiq:
    image: ghcr.io/mastodon/mastodon:latest
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-sidekiq
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: "bundle exec sidekiq"
    environment:
      DB_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-postgres"
      REDIS_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-redis"
